headline: Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech describe an on-device scam-detection model
summary: Google DeepMind says it and Singapore’s GovTech fine-tuned a Gemma-based scam detector intended to analyze conversations on-device, using a lightweight classifier followed by conversation-level analysis for flagged cases. Singapore’s cybersecurity minister separately confirmed the collaboration is in development. A pre-existing GovTech AntiScam Pango beta is already described in official terms as using on-device AI, including an authority-tuned generative model; the sources do not establish whether the new Gemma work integrates with Pango or improves its performance. Neither announcement supplies measured detection accuracy, device cost or reduced scam losses.
